latin: Verum corpus Christi est in coelo localiter, in altari sacramentaliter.

mentions.context: which includes, for instance, an important qualification of efficient causality as necessary disposition, in determining the exact effect of the sacraments on the soul in the process of receiving the grace. From the general role of the sacraments we move, in thesis 14, to discuss the sacrament of the Eucharist.
